exercises.q: I am anticipating a good vacation at the seaside.
exercises.ru: Я ___ приятный отпуск на берегу моря.
exercises.why: **предчувствую** — предчу́вствовать (imperfective): to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about). Wiktionary: предчу́вствие + -овать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: чувстви́тельный — sensitive; предчу́вствовать — to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about); чу́вственный — perceptional, sensory; чу́ткий — sensitive (of a person, instrument, etc.).

exercises.q: She gave him a sensuous smile.
exercises.why: **чувственной** — чу́вственный: perceptional, sensory; sensual. Wiktionary: чу́вство + -енный.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **чуткая** — чу́ткий: sensitive (of a person, instrument, etc.); sharp, keen (sense of hearing, smell, etc.); sympathetic, thoughtful, tactful; light (sleep). Wiktionary: чу́ять + -кий.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **бесчувственная** — бесчу́вственный: insensible, insensitive; unfeeling, callous, hard-hearted, heartless. Wiktionary: бес- + чу́вство + -енный.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: почу́ять — to smell; чутьё — feeling; бесчу́вственный — insensible, insensitive; чувстви́тельность — sensitivity.

exercises.q: I don't want to seem insensitive.
exercises.why: **бесчувственным** — бесчу́вственный: insensible, insensitive; unfeeling, callous, hard-hearted, heartless. Wiktionary: бес- + чу́вство + -енный.
